proof: Yang's canonical ideal has one minimal monomial generator for each concept. The Taylor resolution on $|\mathcal H|$ generators, valid over every field, has length at most $|\mathcal H|-1$ for a nonempty class. Thus $\mathrm Y_p(\mathcal H)\leq|\mathcal H|$ (and the empty class has value 0 by convention).
name: Size / Characteristic-p Yang Dimension
